_comment: FIRA Product Catalogue — edit this file to update all product listings on the website. To integrate a real CMS (Contentful, Sanity, etc.), replace the fetch call in js/cms.js with your CMS API endpoint and map the response to this same shape.
_schema: Dimensions live in width/length/height/thickness (plain strings). Any field that differs by language is an { id, en } object — cms.js picks the active one at render time. Category-level length/width/thickness/profile are shared by every product inside that category (a colour-variant card inherits them rather than repeating them 15-30 times) — see wallpanel-* and plafond-* below.
